About the Conference

Equipping Leaders to
Strengthen the Church

Open to Assistant Life Group Leaders (ALGLs) and above only. Join us for an enriching experience that promises equipping, growth, inspiration, and fellowship.

REACH UP

Reaching UP to God
  • Through developing passionate prayer, worship and relationship with God personally and corporately.
  • Through encountering and experiencing the love of Jesus Christ.

REACH IN

Reaching IN to develop covenantal relationships
  • Through fellowship to develop loving and intimate relationships and sharing of burdens.
  • Through close, loving, authentic relationships with each other.
  • By praying for each other, for their leaders and for the church.
  • By sharing burdens and blessings with each other.

REACH DEEP

Reaching DEEP to make disciples
  • By building strong biblical people through life-changing sharing, teaching, training, accountability, and discipling.
  • By training the members spiritually and practically.

REACH OUT

Reaching OUT to souls in need
  • Through effective witnessing, outreach, evangelism and missions.
  • By bringing pre-believers friends and family members.
  • By encouraging each other and pre-believers with testimonies.

REGISTRATION ALERT: 342 LEADERS REGISTERED!

Excitement is building for the Hope Malaysia Life Group Leader Conference 2026! We are thrilled to announce that 342 Adults have officially registered to join us on this pivotal weekend. With seats filling up rapidly, we are approaching maximum capacity for our venue at Hope Kuala Lumpur.

This conference will be a cornerstone event designed to Refresh, Refuel, and Recommit our hearts to ministry. Through powerful plenaries and deep fellowship, leaders will be equipped across our four focus pillars: Equiping, Growth, Inspiration, and Fellowship.

Target Group: Assistant Life Group Leaders (ALGLs), Life Group Leaders (LGLs), and above.
Venue: Hope Kuala Lumpur, PJ
Status: *Limited seats remaining!

INFORMATION PACK HOPE MALAYSIA LGL CONFERENCE 2026

The official Information Pack for the Hope Malaysia LGL Conference 2026 is now available for download. This comprehensive booklet outlines essential details, including the daily program schedule, registration guidelines, payment information, hotel recommendations, and travel logistics.
